rules.title: A comment says why, not what
rules.text: A comment that paraphrases the line below it ages with the line and adds a second place to be wrong. What earns a comment is a reason, a constraint, a source, or an invariant the code cannot state itself.

judgement.question: Does this comment restate what the code below it does, rather than saying why, what constraint it is under, or where the claim comes from?

criteria.true: the comment paraphrases the code, so deleting it would lose nothing a reader could not see
criteria.false: it states a reason, a source, a constraint, an invariant, or something the code deliberately does not express
